description: Provisional development labels after reading sample-level public metadata; not independent human gold labels

reasons.eligible: Sample-level organism and tissue explicitly support human lung; its own protocol/title mentions a spatial assay. Physical assets not verified.
reasons.non_lung: Sample-level tissue explicitly states right ventricle or larynx/hypopharynx, despite study appearing in a lung keyword query.
reasons.unknown: Lung source is stated, but this sample describes dissociated Chromium scRNA/multiome, not confirmed spatial measurement; no spatial label inherited from the mixed parent study.

coverage_gap: No real mixed-organ/platform sample is present in this first set; mixed handling is tested with fictional unit cases only.
